cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

project(dinero_dep_miniupnpc LANGUAGES C)

if(NOT MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR is required")
endif()

set(_generated_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_generated_dir}")
file(WRITE "${_generated_dir}/miniupnpcstrings.h"
"/* Generated by Dinero depends. */
#ifndef MINIUPNPCSTRINGS_H_INCLUDED
#define MINIUPNPCSTRINGS_H_INCLUDED

#define OS_STRING \"Dinero/depends\"
#define MINIUPNPC_VERSION_STRING \"2.3.3\"
#define UPNP_VERSION_MAJOR 1
#define UPNP_VERSION_MINOR 1
#define UPNP_VERSION_STRING \"UPnP/1.1\"

#endif
")

add_library(miniupnpc STATIC
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/miniwget.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/minixml.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/igd_desc_parse.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/minisoap.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/miniupnpc.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/upnpreplyparse.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/upnpcommands.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/upnperrors.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/connecthostport.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/portlistingparse.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/receivedata.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/upnpdev.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/addr_is_reserved.c"
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/minissdpc.c")

target_include_directories(miniupnpc PUBLIC
  "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
  "${_generated_dir}")

target_compile_definitions(miniupnpc PRIVATE
  MINIUPNPC_SET_SOCKET_TIMEOUT
  MINIUPNPC_GET_SRC_ADDR
  _BSD_SOURCE
  _DEFAULT_SOURCE)

if(APPLE)
  target_compile_definitions(miniupnpc PRIVATE _DARWIN_C_SOURCE)
endif()

if(WIN32)
  # miniupnpc_declspec.h gates __declspec(dllimport) on _WIN32 unless
  # MINIUPNP_STATICLIB is defined. We build a STATIC lib here, so we
  # MUST define it both when compiling the sources (otherwise function
  # bodies hit C2491 "definition of dllimport function not allowed")
  # AND when downstream consumers include the public headers. PUBLIC
  # so the define flows out via target_link_libraries(... miniupnpc).
  target_compile_definitions(miniupnpc PUBLIC MINIUPNP_STATICLIB)
  target_link_libraries(miniupnpc PUBLIC ws2_32 iphlpapi)
endif()

install(TARGETS miniupnpc ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY "${MINIUPNPC_SOURCE_DIR}/include/"
        DESTINATION include/miniupnpc
        FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")

if(WIN32)
  set(_miniupnpc_pc_cflags "-I\${includedir} -DMINIUPNP_STATICLIB")
else()
  set(_miniupnpc_pc_cflags "-I\${includedir}")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/miniupnpc.pc"
"prefix=${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}
exec_prefix=\${prefix}
libdir=\${exec_prefix}/lib
includedir=\${prefix}/include

Name: miniUPnPc
Description: UPnP IGD client lightweight library
URL: https://miniupnp.tuxfamily.org/
Version: 2.3.3
Libs: -L\${libdir} -lminiupnpc
Cflags: ${_miniupnpc_pc_cflags}
")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/miniupnpc.pc"
        DESTINATION lib/pkgconfig)
